desk.headline: Q3 net profit down 16% to ₩1.05tn against last year's one-off gain, above forecasts; no guidance
results: Net profit to shareholders fell to ₩1.05tn from ₩1.24tn, because Q3 2025 included about ₩526bn of one-off non-operating income.
Operating income rose to ₩1.42tn from ₩0.99tn, helped by credit loss charges almost halving to ₩314bn.
Net interest income grew to ₩2.38tn and net fee income to ₩619bn; a ₩566bn loss on fair-value investments was partly offset by ₩466bn of insurance finance income.
Earnings per share were ₩1,389 against ₩1,651 a year earlier; nine-month profit was ₩2.66tn.
Total assets rose to ₩636.0tn from ₩601.5tn at the end of 2025; Tongyang Life became wholly owned in August via a share swap.

guidance.summary: The filing is the reviewed quarterly financial statements and gives no outlook.

points: The group said profit topped ₩1tn for a second straight quarter, crediting a stronger capital position and high-quality assets.
Excluding 2025's one-off gains from buying two life insurers, nine-month profit rose 18.7%.
A Q3 dividend of ₩220 a share was declared, up 10% on a year ago.
Nine-month return on equity improved to 9.9%; the group pledged to keep raising shareholder returns as ROE improves.
call.source: No call transcript found; results coverage — The Korea Herald and The Korea Times (Yonhap), 23 Oct 2026

watch: Credit loss charges and fair-value investment results, which swung sharply this quarter.
Further dividend and buyback steps tied to ROE.
